title: Prove exact phase-preserving widths for H plus one radical (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exhaustive finite corroboration: determine the exact faithful phase-preserving coordinate width of the binary form H direct sum 0, with q(xa+yb+tz)=xy+alpha*x+beta*y+gamma*t.

| gamma | alpha,beta | Exact minimum width |
|---|---|---:|
| 0 | 1,1 | 4 |
| 0 | 0,0 or 1,0 or 0,1 | 6 |
| 1 | any | 5 |

The phase requirement can cost one or two coordinates beyond the cited Gram-only width four. This settles the first working example in Open next question 1 of [PR6456](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6456). Its result is a cited premise, not an audit target. The proof gives direct lower bounds and eight attaining maps; no predecessor executable is imported or replayed.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit PR6456 for the question, Maximooch #831 for the alternating trace and phase-interface motivation with its retained GamingPuzzled and endpoint-normal-form lineage, and thu-nmrc #5464 for related degenerate-embedding background. Polarization and binary even-weight code arguments are classical; no literature-priority claim is made.

Only research/quadratic-hyperbolic-radical-width/ is added. Base main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57; the selected frontier is unchanged. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19571816).

## Evidence

Before, the Gram-only theorem left prescribed quadratic refinements open. After, all eight phase choices have exact minima and literal attaining maps.

- The complete literal census visits 37,450 even-vector triples at widths zero through six. A separate column-multiset census visits 3,003 multisets and weights each by its exact multinomial count. All phase-by-width counts agree, including 3,744 accepted ordered embeddings across the widths.
- Every vector phase and every ordered vector pairing passes for all eight witnesses. Twelve rejection controls pass. Normal and optimized explicit checks produce identical generated receipts bound to all six package-file hashes.
- Both registered commands pass locally on CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only, in 0.031 and 0.031 seconds. These are replay-budget timings, not performance claims.
- PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES with --check-source-history pass at a3f4011a0cbfd565e4726b99fae16a7b3e9468f9. Official committed export and declared-input integrity pass. Both normal and optimized replays pass from a read-only Git-free export with PATH=/nonexistent; all nine exported files remain unchanged and receipts equal the local receipts.
- Warning-strict execution, AST compilation, bounded-function inspection and whitespace checks pass. The source-bound selected baseline orientation passes; it is not a scientific replay.

Exact reproduction from the repository root, substituting another CPython 3.12 executable if needed:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/quadratic-hyperbolic-radical-width/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/quadratic-hyperbolic-radical-width/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/quadratic-hyperbolic-radical-width
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/quadratic-hyperbolic-radical-width --check-source-history
```

The direct scientific marker is PASS_QUADRATIC_HYPERBOLIC_RADICAL_WIDTH. The standalone verifier is read-only and Git-free. SOURCE pins and the exact changed-card scope are in SOURCES.json and TASK.json.

## Limitations

The theorem concerns exactly the three-dimensional binary form H direct sum 0. Larger spaces and radicals are unproved here. No physical native realization, changed source/read incidence, dirty restoration, chronological frame itinerary, owner schedule, precision budget or complete recursive invoice is supplied. No new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. The five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Selected cold replay, Lean, Docker and predecessor scientific suites were not run.

## Open next questions

1. Determine the phase-preserving width for two hyperbolic blocks and one radical direction. Start with the radical phase and quadratic type; higher-dimensional embedding bounds are missing.
2. Bind an attaining map to one actual source/read interface with prescribed phases and chronological frames. Native delivery, restoration, physical owners, precision and a complete signed bill are still blockers.

No follow-on scope is reserved.

## Related open work

No open PR found in the covered live searches studies this exact phase-preserving H direct sum 0 minimum or computes a competing value. The question source #6456 and phase-interface predecessor #831 are merged. Other phase/caller and native-cutoff work concerns different objects. Sparse nested notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

The completion refresh inspected the four other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM: [#7462](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7462), [#7463](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7463), [#7464](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7464) and [#7465](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7465). They concern coordinate-CNOT cancellation, an A1 spectral-projector denominator, compiler plateau widths and mixed line/hyperplane recharts. None studies this quadratic-refinement embedding minimum or computes a competing value. No extra mathematical computations were run to check them.

## CI notes

CI did not certify this package. At unchanged head `a3f4011a0cbfd565e4726b99fae16a7b3e9468f9`, [run 43279182389](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43279182389), [plan job 131395585338](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43279182389/job/131395585338), failed in `Onboarding helper tests`. The actual job log reports 760 tests, exactly one failure and 24 skipped. The failing test is `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`, with an AssertionError that `` `make frontier7000-verify` `` was not found in the CI verification document.

The mismatch is present on canonical base main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. Both base files and the relevant test were inspected; this PR changes none of them. The [package replay job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43279182389/job/131398257475) was skipped because plan failed.

I independently read the failed-job logs of [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790) and [run 43107826591](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43107826591). Each shows the same sole failing test, missing-command assertion and 760-test/24-skipped totals. These logs establish the shared repository-level blocker; they provide no hosted mathematical coverage for this package. All package verification evidence above remains local.

No fix, retrigger commit, push or workflow rerun was made. Repair of main remains with maintainers.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Six new files in one opt-in package; shared sources, pinned predecessor evidence and the selected result are unchanged.
